item.text: {"iteration":1,"pcvs":[{"name":"scheduled_tokens","expression":"scheduler_output.total_num_scheduled_tokens","rationale":"Tracks token-wise model computation and input preparation."},{"name":"scheduled_requests","expression":"len(scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens)","rationale":"Tracks per-request metadata work and vocabulary projection rows."},{"name":"attention_pairs","expression":"sum(scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens[r.req_id] * (2 * r.num_computed_tokens + scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens[r.req_id] + 1) // 2 for r in scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs) + sum(scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens[r] * (2 * c + scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens[r] + 1) // 2 for r, c in zip(scheduler_output.scheduled_cached_reqs.req_ids, scheduler_output.scheduled_cached_reqs.num_computed_tokens))","rationale":"Estimates causal query-key pairs across new and cached requests using entry-state sequence lengths."},{"name":"new_requests","expression":"len(scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs)","rationale":"Captures request initialization and persistent-batch insertion costs."}],"hypothesis":"CPU instruction count is primarily explained by scheduled token volume, attention query-key pairs, output projection rows, and new-request initialization."}
